gate.not.source: 2.0 um CMOS, ~2-3 FO4 (FO4 = 720 ps, R2000 datasheet / CPU-DB)

arith.adder.source: 2.0 um CMOS 32-bit adder with partial carry lookahead = 39 ns (~54 FO4); a ripple is ~80 FO4, a full CLA ~15-20

arith.multiplier.source: estimate, no published 2.0 um array (unused in the corpus)

arith.divider.source: estimate, no published 2.0 um array (unused in the corpus)

mem.register.source: 2.0 um CMOS DFF: clk->Q ~5 FO4, setup ~3 FO4, hold ~1.5 FO4

mem.ram.source: 2.0 um CMOS SRAM: decoder + array = 5 ns + 2 ns/addr bit (32Kx8 external cache SRAM = 35 ns, matching the R2000/12 spec; a 32-word register file = 15 ns)

mem.rom.source: 2.0 um CMOS on-chip ROM/PLA: 16-word control table = 6 ns, 4K words = 14 ns
